description: Estimates paying a bank account from a Poplin account: how much is sent in US dollars, how much arrives in the other currency, the rate, the fees, the limits and how fast it arrives, for personal and business accounts at standard pricing. Use it when someone asks what a payment would cost or how much the recipient would get. It is an estimate; the final terms are shown in the Poplin app before anything is confirmed.
name: get_send_quote
title: Send quote
